title: peristethium phaneroneurum
intro: Peristethium phaneroneurum, commonly known as the "Mountain Mint", is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. The Mountain Mint plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing fever. It is believed to have therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic and antiseptic effects, making it a potential remedy for digestive issues and skin infections. The bioactive constituents present in the Mountain Mint plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
